title: Two Sum
statement: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers that add up to target.

options.title: Brute Force
options.description: Double loop comparing every pair O(n²)
options.explanation: Works, but times out on large inputs. Too slow!

options.title: Hash Map Complement
options.description: Store seen numbers in hash map, check for target - num in O(1)
options.explanation: Optimal! Runs in O(n) time and O(n) space.

options.title: Binary Search
options.explanation: Requires sorting first O(n log n), which messes up original indices.

options.title: Bitmasking
options.explanation: Bit manipulation cannot calculate arithmetic sums directly here.

pseudoHint: Loop through items, check if (target - num) exists in your map, then store the current num.

title: Single Number
statement: Every element in the array appears twice except for one unique element. Find it with linear time and O(1) space.

options.title: Hash Set
options.description: Add on first see, remove on second see
options.explanation: Takes O(n) memory. Problem demands O(1) space!

options.title: Sort and Check Adjacent
options.description: Sort the array and scan in pairs
options.explanation: Sorting takes O(n log n) time. We need O(n).

options.title: XOR Accumulator
options.description: XOR all numbers together; identical numbers cancel out (a ^ a = 0)
options.explanation: Brilliant brain twister! a ^ a = 0 and a ^ 0 = a. Runs in O(n) time, O(1) memory.

options.title: Math Sum Difference
options.explanation: Summing set requires O(n) space and risks integer overflow.

pseudoHint: Initialize res = 0. Iterate through each number and XOR it into res.

title: Valid Parentheses
statement: Given a string s containing just '()[]{}', determine if the input string is valid (closed in correct order).

options.title: Character Counters
options.explanation: Counters miss order validation (e.g. '([)]' has equal counts but is invalid).

options.title: LIFO Stack
options.description: Push opening brackets, pop and match when closing bracket seen
options.explanation: Optimal! Most recent opener must match current closer.

options.title: Recursive String Replace
options.explanation: String copying causes O(n²) time complexity.

options.title: Two Pointers from Edges
options.description: Left pointer and right pointer closing inward

pseudoHint: Push openers to stack. For closers, pop top and check if they match. Return true if stack is empty at end.

title: Missing Number in Range
statement: Given an array nums containing n distinct numbers in the range [0, n], return the only number missing from the range.

options.title: Gauss Formula n*(n+1)//2
options.description: Subtract sum(nums) from expected arithmetic progression sum
options.explanation: Runs in O(n) time and O(1) space with minimal lines of logic!

options.title: Sorting
options.description: Sort and check where indices mismatch
options.explanation: Sorting requires O(n log n) time.

options.title: Nested Search
options.description: Check if each i from 0..n is in nums

options.title: Frequency Array
options.explanation: Takes O(n) auxiliary memory. O(1) space is achievable.

pseudoHint: Calculate expected sum from 0 to n using n*(n+1)//2, then subtract the actual sum of array elements.
